reason: Build script only (#621 item 2): gen-known-labels reads the locale registry through the shared fail-closed reader (registry-source.mjs) instead of a regex, so a double-quoted locale code or a re-indented registry can no longer drop locales from known.generated.ts, and a registry read with no non-base locale stops the generator. The generated file is unchanged. Tests in scripts/gen-known-labels.test.mjs.
